memberdef.name: getCellGuidesSvg

briefdescription.para: Builds one cell's codepoint label plus its guide-line overlay.

detaileddescription.para: Writes glyphText as an escaped Svg <text> label at the cell's top-left, one horizontal hairline <path> per manifest guides-table row (at that row's offset from the cell top, in the colour-table colour of the row's key), and one vertical hairline <path> at each unit-cell edge inside the glyph and at the glyph's advance. The edge and advance positions follow the build's own advance rule, applied to cellBounds and metrics.

parameterdescription.para: The font family manifest, read for its guides and colour tables.
The manifest's metrics value tree, read for the cell width, plain advance and sheet scale.
The cell's rectangle within the glyph sheet.
The label's fill colour, as colour-table text.
The colour of the vertical unit-cell edge and advance lines.

simplesect.para: The cell's label and guide-line Svg markup.
